label: NetBotz Rack Monitor 250 environmental monitor
description: 1U rack environmental and access-control appliance that polls wired and Zigbee wireless APC sensors for temperature, humidity, spot/rope leak, smoke, vibration and door state, and raises SNMP traps, syslog and email alerts. A single 10/100BASE-T RJ45 public LAN port faces the network; the six RJ45 ports on the unit are APC Universal Sensor (A-Link) ports, not Ethernet.
notes: NetBotz family brochure connector row for NBRK0250A: '(1) 10/100 Base-T Public LAN, (6) APC Universal Sensor, (2) Access Control Handles, (2) Door Contact, ... (1) Mini-USB Console Port'; protocols A-Link, DHCP, DNS, HTTPS, SMTP, SNMP v1/v3, SSHv2, TCP/IP, TLS 1.2. Supports 42 wired / 47 wireless sensors. The 750-series (NBRK0750, NBWL0755/0756) is the Gigabit variant.
